intro: We hold a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹{{budget}} lakh for {{count}} published BHM colleges in India. This list of the best BHM colleges under ₹{{budget}} lakh mixes hotel-management degrees with tourism and diploma cards, so read the programme name first.

Abhi Institute of Hotel Management, Delhi, is listed with BHMCT and a fee range of ₹30,000–₹1.40 lakh, which already crosses the ₹1 lakh cap at the top end. Jamia Millia Islamia's tourism department follows, with a recorded BTTM fee of ₹30,085.
Delhi NCR and Punjab have the most colleges here. NCHMCT JEE is the main recorded entrance test, though several cards are not IHM-style BHM programmes.
listLead: These are the top BHM colleges in India 2026 with a recorded fee of up to ₹1 lakh. Some first cards are BA Tourism, B.Sc Hotel Management, or a diploma in front office, not a full BHM degree.
snapshot: Across {{feeN}} published colleges with a recorded fee, the median total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
{{private}} colleges are private, {{public}} is public, and one has no ownership type. Five records have a fee band that can exceed ₹1 lakh even though the minimum is under the cap.
NCHMCT JEE is tagged at 12 colleges. A hotel-management degree that admits through NCHMCT JEE may have a different official fee from the tourism or diploma card shown here.
firstCollegesLead: Jamia's recorded programme is a Bachelor's in Tourism and Travel Management, not a BHM. Roorkee College of Engineering is listed with BA Tourism Management at ₹39,600, which is also not a hotel-management degree.

Dangayach College of Hotel Management, Jaipur, is listed with a Diploma in Front Office at ₹50,000. Management and Design Academy, Delhi, is listed with an Advanced Diploma in Hotel Management at the same figure.

sections.heading: Degrees, diplomas and tourism courses on this BHM list
paragraphs: If you want a full Bachelor of Hotel Management, skip cards that are clearly a one-year diploma or a tourism BA, even when the recorded fee is attractive.
Hope Institute of Hospitality Management and Rayat Bahra Institute of Management have recorded BHM fees of ₹50,000. Confirm whether that is annual or for the full course.

compare.heading: How to compare the best BHM colleges under ₹1 lakh
paragraphs: A university BTTM, a private BHM, and a front-office diploma are not the same qualification, even when all three appear on a BHM fee list.
bullets: The exact award on the official brochure: BHM, BHMCT, B.Sc Hotel Management, BTTM, or a diploma.
Whether the fee is for one year or the full programme, and whether uniforms, labs or internships are extra.
The admission test, including NCHMCT JEE where it applies, and any university-level process.
The official campus city, because Delhi, Jaipur, Mohali and Jalandhar living costs differ.

faqs.question: How many BHM colleges in India have fees under ₹1 lakh here?
faqs.answer: We list {{published}} published colleges with a recorded main-programme fee up to ₹{{budget}} lakh. Some of those programmes are tourism degrees or diplomas, not a full BHM.

faqs.question: What is a typical fee on this BHM list?
faqs.answer: The median recorded total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}. Confirm the official full-course fee, especially where our card shows a range.

faqs.question: Why does the first college show a fee above ₹1 lakh?
faqs.answer: Abhi Institute of Hotel Management has a recorded range of ₹30,000–₹1.40 lakh. Our filter uses the main recorded fee, and the upper end can exceed the cap, so read both numbers on the card.

faqs.question: Do all colleges here admit through NCHMCT JEE?
faqs.answer: No. NCHMCT JEE is recorded at 12 colleges on this list. Others may use a university process or direct admission. Check the official brochure.

faqs.question: Is this a ranking of the best BHM colleges under ₹1 lakh?
faqs.answer: It is a fee filter, not a ranking of kitchens, internships or hotel tie-ups. Use the programme name and the official fee notice before you shortlist.
